text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: That's pretty tough to pull off...
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't win it...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I knew it, you did it for me—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Please don't let it bother you! Just 
knowing you care means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there are plenty of other ways 
to make little kids happy besides 
plushies!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Like singing, for instance! Oh, I 
know—maybe I should practice some songs 
from recent anime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
